title: Volta's own question (inspired by: Skewness Premium for Short‐Term Exposure to Squared Market R; The Allocation of Talent: Implications for Growth)
idea: When the overnight gap as a proportion of the 20‑day average NY range (k_gap / k_range20) is large, are we more likely to close the NQ session above yesterday's high (y_closed_above_yday_high)?

spec.question: When the overnight gap as a proportion of the 20‑day average NY range (k_gap / k_range20) is large, are we more likely to close the NQ session above yesterday's high (y_closed_above_yday_high)?
spec.explain: Inspired by research on how gap size influences breakout outcomes, this asks whether a gap measured relative to the typical range (rather than absolute) better predicts a close above yesterday's high.
